value.answer: In Toronto, the free option is Ontario Structured Psychotherapy. It gives free CBT for depression and anxiety, you don't need a health card, and you can self-refer at ontariohealth.ca/osp. It isn't right for everyone, so an intake clinician checks whether it fits. Other low-cost choices: Toronto Community Psychotherapy & Counselling Centre offers free counselling through an income-based application, and the Centre for Training in Psychotherapy had student-therapist sessions at $45, though that price is from an older list and may have changed. I couldn't confirm any of these are taking new clients right now. If things get urgent, reach emergency services right away.
